import os,re,collections
root="AlgebraicJacobian"
allmods={}
for dp,dn,fn in os.walk(root):
    for f in fn:
        if f.endswith(".lean"):
            p=os.path.join(dp,f)
            mod=p[:-5].replace("/",".")
            allmods[mod]=p
allmods["AlgebraicJacobian"]="AlgebraicJacobian.lean"
imports=collections.defaultdict(list)
for mod,p in allmods.items():
    try:
        txt=open(p).read()
    except: continue
    for m in re.finditer(r'^import\s+([A-Za-z0-9_.]+)', txt, re.M):
        imports[mod].append(m.group(1))
# BFS from root
seen=set()
stack=["AlgebraicJacobian"]
while stack:
    m=stack.pop()
    if m in seen: continue
    seen.add(m)
    for d in imports.get(m,[]):
        if d in allmods and d not in seen:
            stack.append(d)
unreach=sorted(set(allmods)-seen)

print("UNREACHABLE:",len(unreach))

    n=m.split(".")[-1]
    for k in ["DivRep","HighWindow","Redesign","DivScheme","Pic0","Divisor","Cert"]:
        if k in n: byprefix[k]+=1; break
    else: byprefix["other"]+=1
print(byprefix)
print("--- all unreachable ---")
for m in unreach: print("  ",m)
EOF

-/
